desc:
While Shadow infiltrated this world, it went entirely unnoticed that another adversary had surreptitiously entered alongside him. The Heavens had already endeavored to intervene, and the Almighty of the World had attempted to safeguard the realm. However, since Shadow had partially paved the way, it facilitated a slightly easier entry for the new threat known as Triple Eyes.

Simultaneously, the tombs of xdggjai unveiled a crucial piece of the past.

Furthermore, pirates who have navigated the Second Sea consistently state that Cake Island is an exceptional location, holding novel treasures that grant them the prosperity required to acquire superior Devil Fruit abilities.
